claudeCommitGen.prompt: Generate a Conventional Commits style commit message for the staged diff below.  BRANCH: {{BRANCH_NAME}}  Ticket reference: - Extract the ticket ID from BRANCH only — never from the diff, filenames or code. - Take the FIRST match of, in order:   1. Jira/Linear style: [A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}-\d+   -> use verbatim (e.g. PROJ-1234)   2. Bare number as a path/prefix segment: (?:^|/|-)(\d{1,6})(?:-|$) -> emit as #1234 - Ignore main, master, develop, release/*, and any branch with no match. - If no ID is found, omit the reference line entirely. Never invent, guess or   infer an ID.  Format: <type>(<scope>): <subject>  <optional body>  Refs: <TICKET>  Rules: - type: feat|fix|refactor|perf|docs|test|build|ci|chore|style - scope: affected component/module from the diff, or omit if unclear.   Do NOT put the ticket ID in the scope. - subject: imperative mood, lowercase, no trailing period, whole line < 72 chars. - body: only if the "why" is not obvious from the subject; wrap at 72 chars,   use "- " bullets for multiple changes. - breaking change: add "!" after type/scope AND a "BREAKING CHANGE: <desc>" footer. - Output ONLY the commit message. No code fences, no preamble, no explanation.
